body: MAINLINE-021b filed. On 019's optimistic reserve, with SR-200 sheet faces at their own sourced properties (290 GPa; 345 MPa datasheet minimum tensile yield, taken as compressive), a hull floats on three of five named optimisms: gamma on the 018 curve, the wrinkling coefficient and panel size. Largest usage is 0.834; no pair floats. The point: Hexcel CR-III 5056 3/8-1.0 (16 kg/m3), faces 0.6917 mm, core 30.12 mm, R 10 m, 3.13 m panels, film 0.030 lb/ft2. Masses: faces 3216.3 kg, core 606.3, joint allowance 191.1, systems 100, reserve 775.7 (019's fixed items 411.3 plus joint excess 364.4). Vc 0.886. It needs gamma 0.468 (2.34x CR-1457's 0.20; the curve gives 0.554), wrinkle 0.609 (1.85x 0.33) and panels 3.42x today's 0.914 m stock equivalent. Face and film stay at today's values. Face compression sits exactly at 1; global and wrinkling are 1.000, crimp 3.10, crush 5.06, dimpling 4.98. With gamma, wrinkle and the SR-200 lot's 379 MPa at full: 1.099. Conservative gamma: 0.431. Taking 019's 535.95 kg as given, the least set would be gamma plus wrinkling at 0.666. That reserve embeds 4 m panels and 0.015 lb/ft2 films; at today's panel and film this point needs 1229 kg. On 015's map, gamma 0.468 allows one 46 mm dimple. With every optimism full: aluminium 1.199, aramid 0.941 (crimp-blocked), fiberglass 1.039. 019 and 021 are reproduced. QUESTIONABLE, not a certification.
